text:
- Preprocess positions and neighbors: store grid values and their coordinates; build a function to get in-bounds 4-neighbors; create a sorted list of all starting cells by value to explore lexicographically minimal prefixes first.
- Iteratively build the lexicographically minimal sequence of length k using layered BFS with pruning: maintain a frontier of positions that can yield the current prefix; for step t from 1..k, compute all next states (neighbors including staying? no, moves must be to neighbors; revisit allowed via back-and-forth), collect the minimal value among reachable cells, filter next frontier to only positions with that minimal value, and append that value to the answer.
- Optimize by using boolean visited layers per step (not across steps) and early termination when frontier becomes empty; ensure uniqueness guarantees correctness, and handle k=1 by picking global minimum cell; time complexity O(k * N^2) in worst case.
